AcOpfResiduals.description:
Independent AC OPF checks, with units stated per family. Objective agreement
is separate from primal feasibility. Bounds are evaluated only when selected.

AcPfInitialization.description: Successful AC initialization, including any fallback from the requested start.

attempts.description: Starts attempted, including the successful one (one-based).

AcPfStartStrategy.description: Initialization that produced a converged AC power flow.

Bound.description: A min or max bound, e.g. the lower/upper voltage-magnitude limit.

BranchConstraintResult.description: A DC OPF branch's thermal constraint in the final solved program.

binding.description: An enforced bound is met to the solver's reporting tolerance.

relief_per_mw.description:
Objective decrease per additional MW of symmetric rating. Only present
for an enforced row with an economic objective.

BranchFlow.description:
Branch flows, keyed by original branch id (plus the row uid when carried, as in
[`BusScalar`]). `pf` (from-end active, MW) and `loading` (|S|/limit,
dimensionless) are present on every formulation that has flows; the reactive
and to-end legs are `None` on the DC paths.

BranchLoading.description:
Interpretation of `loading`, independent of economic binding or enforcement.
An absent rating means no known equipment limit, even if a numerical solver
fallback produced a finite utilization. Older responses omit this object.

BranchScalar.description: A branch-indexed voltage product, in squared per unit.

BusInjection.description:
A nodal net injection (MW / MVAr), keyed by original bus id (plus the row uid
when carried, as in [`BusScalar`]). Injections describe the net nodal power balance.

BusScalar.description:
A scalar keyed by original bus id (LMP, voltage, angle, squared magnitude).
`uid` is the bus's powerio row uid when the solved network carried one, so an
overlay can re-key on stable identity instead of the positional id.

ColMeta.description: Identity and quantity metadata for one column of a [`SensitivityMatrix`].

index.description: Dense index of the element this column varies.

ConstraintResult.description:
The solved state of one [`LinearConstraint`], in request order. `value`,
`lower`, and `upper` are MW; `shadow_price` is in objective units per MW, the
same units as `lmp`.

binding.description:
`value` sits at a limit, within solver tolerance. Always true for an
equality.

branches.description: Branches in the resolved row, including flows implied by injection terms.

shadow_price.description:
The objective decrease per MW the binding limit is raised:
`-d objective / d limit`. Positive when the upper limit binds, negative
when the lower limit binds, zero when neither does. A bus's price then
differs from its island's reference bus's by `-shadow_price` times the
change in `value` per MW injected at the bus and withdrawn at that reference.
Absent when the declared objective gives prices no economic meaning, as
for `lmp`.

CostTerm.description: Which generation-cost coefficient: the quadratic `cq` or the linear `cl`.

DcFormula.description: The complete DC convention, including taps and phase shifts.

oneOf.description: Legacy Tellegen: series susceptance with shifts, ignoring taps.
MATPOWER / PowerModels DCMP: ignore resistance, include taps and shifts.
Textbook 1/x, ignoring taps and shifts.
Ignore conductance: series susceptance divided by tap, with shifts.
PowerModels DCP (PGLib DC baseline): ignore taps and shifts.

ElementId.description:
A source-id reference for a dense row or column, so a [`SensitivityMatrix`]
self-describes and the api serializes it without re-deriving id maps.

oneOf.description: A caller-supplied linear constraint, by its position in the request.

End.description: Which end of a branch a flow is measured at.

GB.description: Conductance `g` or susceptance `b`, the real/imaginary parts of an admittance.

GenDispatch.description: Generator dispatch, keyed by original generator id. `qg` is `None` on the DC paths.

bus.description: Original bus identity, allowing exact aggregation of co-located dispatch.

anyOf.description: Newton iteration count and final infinity-norm mismatch (acpf).

Nonlinear-program diagnostics. The primal residual is Tellegen's
independent maximum P/Q balance mismatch in MW/MVAr; other residuals
are separated by family below or reported by POUNCE.

base_restoration_calls.description: Restoration entries in the original solve, even when a retry wins.

base_solver_status.description: Status before recovery; absent in older responses.

restoration_calls.description: Restoration entries in the selected solve (not the whole ladder).

total_nlp_iterations.description: Base plus every retry, including rejected attempts.

Iterations.description:
The convergence record. OPF paths carry the full interior-point trace (for the
solve-card sparkline); the AC power flow carries its Newton count and final
mismatch. Untagged: the OPF arm serializes to the same bare array the DC OPF
always returned.

LimitRound.description:
One solve of a DC OPF run under [`LimitOptions`]: the program it solved and
how the solution met the enforceable thermal limits. A run without lazy
enforcement has one round.

added.description:
Limits added for the next round: the unenforced ones the flows violate
or meet, and those loaded at or above `near_binding`.

enforced.description: Thermal limits the round's program enforced.

ipm_iterations.description: Interior-point iterations of the round's solve.

max_loading.description: The largest loading over the enforceable limits, as a fraction.

variables.description: Variables and constraint rows of the round's program.

violated.description: Enforceable limits the round's solution violated; zero on the last round.

LoadingBasis.description: Basis of the dimensionless branch utilization, with the rating in MW or MVA.

ObjectiveKind.description:
What the solved OPF minimized, as PowerIO declared it for the case. A case
with no generator cost data declares a feasibility problem: the reported
`objective` is then zero by construction and prices and limit multipliers
are left out, because any feasible point is optimal and they are not unique.

oneOf.description: Total generator cost, in the case's cost units.
No cost was declared; the solve found a feasible operating point.

Operand.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *of*, named for the physical power quantity rather
than a formulation's internal variable. The orthogonal sub-axes (active/reactive,
from/to, voltage representation) are visible to the type system; each formulation
maps a request to its own KKT rows or returns [`SensError::Unsupported`].

The dialects fold into one vocabulary: DC `Angle` is `Voltage(Angle)`, the conic
squared magnitude `w` is `Voltage(Squared)`, the nodal price is `Price(Active)`.

oneOf.description:
Nodal-balance dual (the LMP for active power, the reactive price for
reactive), per bus.
Generator dispatch `pg` / `qg`, per generator.
Branch active/reactive flow at the from/to end, per branch.

Bus voltage in the formulation's representation (`vm` / `va` / `w` / `wr` /
`wi`), per bus.

Parameter.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *with respect to* — the parameter whose hand-derived
`dK/dp` column drives the solve.

oneOf.description: Bus active/reactive demand `pd` / `qd`, per bus.
Generation cost coefficient, per generator.
DC thermal limit `fmax` / AC-conic apparent-power `|S|` limit, per branch.
Branch series admittance `g` / `b`, per branch.
Bus shunt admittance `gs` / `bs`, per bus.
Voltage-magnitude bound right-hand side (the `w = |V|²` bound), per bus.

Generator output bound right-hand side (`pmax` / `pmin` / `qmax` / `qmin`),
per generator.
Transformer tap ratio / phase shift, per branch.
Branch switching state `sw` in `[0, 1]`, per branch.

A shift of both limits of a caller-supplied linear constraint (the
fixed value of an equality), per constraint in request order.

Power.description:
Active or reactive power. The orthogonal P/Q sub-axis shared by prices,
dispatch, flows, and demand.

PowerFlowStart.description:
Where the AC power flow's Newton iteration starts, as the lowercase JSON tags
`"flat"` and `"case"`. Only `acpf` iterates from a start; every other
formulation refuses `"case"`.

oneOf.description: Voltage setpoint magnitudes and every angle at its island's reference angle.

The case's stored bus voltages: each bus's magnitude and its angle
relative to its island's reference bus (star buses of three-winding transformers
where the source carries them), or a typed instance's initial point. A
stored state that does not converge falls back to the flat start.

PriceValue.description:
The served DC value shapes (the HTTP JSON format). The engine returns the
common `BusScalar` / `BranchFlow` / `GenDispatch`; the server maps
those to the DC-specific field names the frontend reads.

Problem.description:
Which problem to solve. The convex/power flow solve paths, as the lowercase JSON
tags `"dcpf"`/`"dcopf"`/`"acpf"`/`"socwr"`. A plain (not internally tagged) enum
so a request that omits it defaults to [`DcOpf`](Problem::DcOpf), and `{}` is a
valid base-case DC OPF request.

The `"acopf"` tag enables full nonlinear AC OPF only when the opt-in `acopf`
feature is built. Shipping adapters do not forward that feature.

oneOf.description:
DC power flow: angles and flows at the fixed generator setpoints. No prices,
no dispatch, no sensitivity.
DC OPF: the LMP / dispatch / flow workhorse. Differentiable via the DC KKT.

AC polar Newton power flow. Voltages and nodal injections. Differentiable
via the AC Newton system.
SOCWR (Jabr) conic relaxation of AC OPF. Differentiable via the conic KKT.
Full nonlinear AC OPF through the opt-in POUNCE backend.

RowMeta.description: Identity and quantity metadata for one row of a [`SensitivityMatrix`].

index.description: Dense index of the element this row reports.

SensitivityMatrix.description:
A self-describing sensitivity result: `values[r][c] = d(rows[r])/d(cols[c])`,
with row and column metadata naming each quantity and its source element, and the
served-unit label.

values.description:
`values[r][c] = d(operand_r)/d(parameter_c)`, in the units named by `units`. The
engine produces per-unit values; the api edge rescales to served units.

objective_kind.description:
`cost` when the solved OPF minimized the case's generator cost,
`feasibility` when the case declares none (`objective` is then zero
and `prices` is empty).

SolveDiagnostic.description:
A finding about how the solve treated the network, such as an island left out
because nothing supplies it. `code` is stable for programs; `message` is for
people. `buses` names the original ids of the buses concerned.

code.description:
`island_deenergized`: an island with no in-service generator was left
out of the solve; its buses carry no results and its load is unserved.
The message is PowerIO's finding; for an island an HVDC line fed, it
names the lines taken out of service with the island and the power
they scheduled into it.
`island_reference_designated`: a supplied island stated no reference bus,
so the bus of its largest generator became the island's reference.
`island_extra_reference`: the AC power flow found several reference
buses in one island and kept the first as its slack; the others hold
their voltage magnitude as PV (or PQ) buses.
`BUILD.HVDC.FIXED_INJECTION`: PowerIO's statement of what the in-service
HVDC lines inject as fixed transfers at their terminal buses.
`BUILD.HVDC.TERMINAL_INACTIVE`: an in-service HVDC line has a terminal bus
outside the solve, so neither end injects; `buses` are its two terminals.
`settings_ignored`: a reopened Study could not apply some or all of the
calculation settings its saved module recorded, such as an option this
engine does not know; engine defaults stand in for what was dropped.

SolveIteration.description:
One interior-point iterate: the iteration index, the primal objective, and
the primal and dual residuals. Collected once per Clarabel iteration to draw
the convergence plot. Shape matches the frontend `SolveIteration`.

SolveOutput.description:
A solve result as the JSON entry points and adapters emit it: every
[`SolveResponse`] field at the top level, plus facts about the solved
problem that the response does not hold.

`objective_kind` is derived from the problem each time a result is emitted,
never stored: it says whether the OPF minimized a declared generator cost
or only looked for a feasible point. It is present for every OPF
formulation (`dcopf`, `socwr`, `acopf`) and absent for power flows.

branch_constraints.description: Thermal constraint state and marginal relief, when exposed by the formulation.

branch_susceptance_formula.description: Resolved DC convention; absent for AC results and older saved responses.

constraints.description:
The request's linear constraints, in request order (dcopf). Absent when
the request stated none.

diagnostics.description:
How the solve treated the network's islands. Empty, and omitted, when
every island is supplied and referenced as stated.

formulation.description: The formulation that produced this, echoed for the client.

initialization.description: Successful AC power-flow start. Absent for other formulations and legacy results.

limit_rounds.description:
The solves a DC OPF ran under the request's `limits` (dcopf with
`limits` only).

lmp.description:
Active nodal price when the solved OPF declares a network generator
cost objective. Feasibility solves leave this absent.

lmp_q.description:
Reactive nodal price. Always `None` in this build; the field is retained for
wire-format stability.

sensitivities.description:
One self-describing matrix per requested cell, in request order. Each carries
its own row/column element ids and the served-unit label.

va.description: Voltage angle, radians (every path except socwr, which is W-space).

vm.description: Voltage magnitude, per unit (ACPF or square root of SOCWR squared magnitude).

w.description:
Squared voltage magnitude `w = |V|^2`, per unit squared (socwr). The conic
relaxation does not guarantee a globally consistent set of voltage angles.

wr.description: Real and imaginary oriented branch voltage products (SOCWR).

SolveStatus.description: A solve outcome that succeeded. A failed solve is the `Err` arm of a solve entry.

oneOf.description: An OPF reached optimality.
A power flow or local AC OPF solve reached a validated feasible point.

objective_kind.description:
`cost` when the solved OPF minimized the case's generator cost,
`feasibility` when the case declares none (`objective` is then zero
and `prices` is empty).

TapKind.description: A transformer control: the tap ratio or the phase-shift angle.

VoltageKind.description:
How a voltage operand is represented: polar (`Magnitude`, `Angle`) for the AC
power flow, or the W-space lift (`Squared` = `|V|²`, `ProductReal` = `Re(Vi Vj*)`,
`ProductImag` = `Im(Vi Vj*)`) for the conic relaxation.
